verdict.rationale: Make's own docs show scenarios that run unattended: they can be scheduled, triggered by webhooks, and process webhook queues every time schedule criteria are met. An AI Agents app adds agentic automation, and error handlers support unattended runs. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of recurring schedule options and background execution behavior (the scheduling evidence is mostly page titles and snippets), independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous runs, and detail on how AI agents run without supervision.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
